messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: prod-api-error-rate spike > 12% for 5m on cluster 'eu-west-1-prod'. Priority: P1. Runbooks: /runbooks/api-502. Pager sent to @maya @devon

maya: seeing it in grafana, 502s from auth-service token-validate. Traces: latency spike + increased 5xx on ingress LB. I’m jumping on a quick bridge now.

devon: oncall-standby, pulling logs. any recent deploys?

maya: no deploys in the last 24h, but autoscaler did replace 2 pods ~10m ago.

samira: tagging in because this looks like kv-cache timeouts we saw last month — same stack trace pattern? attaching snippet:
```
Error: downstream EOF while reading body
at http2_session_on_stream_end (internal/http2/compat.js)
```

maya: logs match. I’m rolling a temporary routing rule to bypass auth-service -> auth-cache for now (canary). will route 10% traffic.

jules: thanks — if that stabilizes we should plan a controlled rollout to 100% then follow-up. keep customer-impact notes updated.

oncall-pager-bot: Bridge created: https://zoom.company/bridge/2487654321 — Recording enabled.

maya: 10% reroute done. KPIs: error-rate down from 12% -> 6% in ~90s. latency still a bit elevated.

devon: checking pod logs, I’m seeing repeated 504s between auth-cache and upstream DB pool exhaustion. scaling DB read pool temp to +20 connections.

samira: marking impacted customers list in the incident doc: customers with >50 reqs/min were impacted for ~6m. no billing anomalies reported yet.

maya: great. I want to schedule a post-incident review tomorrow to capture action items and update runbook. who can attend?

jules: I can do tomorrow 10am PT. propose 30m.

devon: +1 10am PT. I’ll bring logs and timeline.

samira: available — will draft the initial RCA notes and candidate fixes (kv cache pool metrics, DB conn limits).

maya: action items I’m assigning now:
- maya: add temporary reroute play to runbook with exact commands used.
- devon: add DB pool alert + autoscale suggestion to runbook.
- samira: create a prompt-based eval to catch auth-cache signature failures in QA.
- jules: own postmortem doc and coordinate customer comms if needed.

maya: also proposing these runbook edits (snippet):
```
- detection: if 5xx rate > 10% for 5m on api-gateway -> alert oncall
- mitigation-step-1: route 10% traffic to auth-service-bypass: curl -X POST https://routing/api/bypass -d '{"percent":10, "target":"auth-bypass"}'
- mitigation-step-2: scale db read pool: kubectl scale deploy db-read --replicas 3
- verification: check grafana panel: api.errors.rate and auth.latency
```

devon: minor nit: add a step to pin config and not trigger autoscaler immediately — last time autoscaler churned pods and made things worse.

maya: good catch. adding note.

oncall-pager-bot: :white_check_mark: Pager cleared by maya at 2487654365 — error rate back to 0.8% and baseline latency.

maya: closing bridge in 10. scheduling postmortem 2026-03-16 17:00 UTC (10am PT). Meeting link: https://zoom.company/pm-2487654321. Jules will own doc at /docs/incidents/2487654321. Please add any evidence or timeline bullets before the meeting.

jules: created postmortem doc and calendar invite. tagging ops-eng and platform-sre.

samira: I’ll open a PR for runbook edits with the temporary reroute and the DB alert. putting TODO labels and test checklist.

maya: thanks all. quick retrospective: the routing rollback pattern helped reduce customer impact quickly. long-term: we need better DB pool telemetry and a runbook section for autoscaler interactions.

devon: agree. I’ll follow up with a small spike to add pool metrics into our exporter this sprint.

jules: adding owners and due dates in the postmortem doc now.

maya: :thumbsup: good work. I’ll post a short summary to #incidents when the postmortem is done.

oncall-pager-bot: Note: follow-up actions created: RB-431 (runbook edit), INF-982 (db metrics), PM-121 (postmortem writeup).
